title: Chain of Physics: Supporting Fault Diagnosis with Engineering-Inspired Large Language Model Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.14263v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fault diagnosis in complex systems requires linking observed changes in physical quantities to the failure mechanisms that produce them. Experienced engineers perform this task by combining sensor information with knowledge of system behavior and fault propagation. Large Language Models (LLMs) can support this process, but their diagnostic reasoning depends on the availability of asset-specific engineering knowledge and on how this knowledge is represented and used during inference. This work introduces Chain of Physics (CoP), an LLM-based fault-diagnosis framework built around a Constrained Knowledge Graph (CKG) generated automatically from asset-specific reference documentation. CoP addresses failure-sensor association from textual engineering knowledge. The CKG stores diagnostic chains connecting failure modes, changes in physical quantities, and monitoring sensors. translated_title: 物理链：基于工程启发的LLM推理支持故障诊断
translated_abstract: 复杂系统中的故障诊断需要将观察到的物理量变化与产生这些变化的失效机制联系起来。经验丰富的工程师通过将传感器信息与系统行为及故障传播知识相结合来完成这项任务。大语言模型（LLM）可以支持这一过程，但其诊断推理依赖于特定资产的工程知识的可用性，以及这些知识在推理过程中如何被表示和使用。本工作提出了“物理链”，这是一个基于LLM的故障诊断框架，其核心是由特定资产的参考文档自动生成的约束知识图谱（CKG）。CoP从文本形式的工程知识中解决失效与传感器的关联问题。CKG存储了连接失效模式、物理量变化和监测传感器的诊断链。在推理过程中，系统会检索语义相似的图路径用于诊断。
tldr: 该论文提出“物理链”框架，通过从资产参考文档自动构建约束知识图谱来存储失效模式、物理量变化与传感器之间的诊断链，使大语言模型能够结合工程知识进行故障诊断推理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Chain of Physics (CoP), an LLM-based fault-diagnosis framework that automatically constructs a Constrained Knowledge Graph from asset reference documentation to store diagnostic chains linking failure modes, physical quantity changes, and monitoring sensors, enabling engineering-grounded reasoning.
